faqHeading: What Baton Rouge asks before renting.

faqs.a: A bathroom or a single room of flooring usually fits in a 10 or 15 yard. A kitchen, a whole-house flooring job or a big cleanout is a 20. A flooded house or new construction usually needs a 30 or 40. Tell us the job and we will help you pick.

faqs.q: Can it go on the street?
faqs.a: On your own driveway or lot, there is usually nothing to file. If it has to sit on a street or right-of-way in Baton Rouge or one of the surrounding cities, check with that city first.

faqs.q: My yard is soft. Is that a problem?
faqs.a: It can be. A loaded roll-off is heavy, and Baton Rouge ground stays wet a long time after rain. Pick a spot on concrete or a firm drive if you can, and tell us about it when you call.

Paint, chemicals, oil, tires, batteries and refrigerators or freezers with refrigerant are generally not allowed. Heavy materials like concrete and dirt can go in a box sized for them. Ask if you are unsure.

faqs.q: How long can I keep it?
faqs.a: Rentals are set by days, and you can extend. Call when it is full or when you are done and it gets picked up.

faqs.q: Do you pick up and swap on job sites?
faqs.a: Yes. On construction and big cleanouts, a full box can be hauled and an empty one set down in its place.

pages.heading: Remodel dumpster rental in Baton Rouge.
pages.intro: A roll-off in the driveway turns a remodel's debris into one trip — cabinets, tile, drywall and old flooring go straight out the door.
pages.seoTitle: Remodel Dumpster Rental Baton Rouge LA | Baton Rouge Dumpster
pages.seoDescription: Driveway dumpsters for kitchen, bath and flooring remodels in Baton Rouge, Central, Prairieville and Denham Springs.

sections.heading: Look up before you pick the spot.
sections.body: Live oaks and power lines are the two things that stop a roll-off truck in Baton Rouge. The truck needs to back straight in and tip the box down, so pick a spot with clear room overhead.

sections.heading: Old houses are heavy houses.
sections.body: Older homes in Mid City, the Garden District and Southdowns often have tile set in mortar, plaster walls or layers of old flooring. All of it is heavy. Mention it when you call so the box is sized by weight, not just by space.

sections.heading: Check the rules in the newer subdivisions.
sections.body: Many subdivisions in south Baton Rouge, Prairieville and Central limit how long a dumpster can sit out. A quick look at the HOA rules before delivery avoids a letter.

pages.heading: Commercial and construction dumpster rental in Baton Rouge.
pages.intro: Roll-offs for general contractors, home builders and commercial sites, with swap-outs so the box is never the thing holding the job up.
pages.seoTitle: Construction Dumpster Rental Baton Rouge LA | Baton Rouge Dumpster
pages.seoDescription: 30 and 40 yard construction dumpsters for builders and contractors in Baton Rouge, Zachary, Gonzales and Port Allen, with swap-outs.

sections.heading: Forties for framing, smaller for demo.
sections.body: A 30 or 40 yard handles framing scrap, packaging and drywall on new builds. On demolition or interior tear-outs with a lot of masonry, two smaller boxes are often better than one big one that hits its weight limit half full.

sections.heading: Plan for rain, because it is coming.
sections.body: Set the dumpster on the firmest part of the site, and somewhere the truck can still reach after a week of afternoon storms. A rutted access road slows down every swap.

sections.heading: Separate when it pays.
sections.body: On big jobs, a separate box for concrete or clean metal can make sense. Ask when you set up the job.

pages.heading: Flood and hurricane cleanup dumpsters in Baton Rouge.
pages.intro: After high water, everything below the water line has to come out — carpet, drywall, insulation, cabinets and furniture. A dumpster gets it out of the house and off the curb.
pages.seoTitle: Flood Cleanup Dumpster Rental Baton Rouge | Baton Rouge Dumpster
pages.seoDescription: Dumpster rental for flood muck-outs and hurricane cleanup in Baton Rouge, Denham Springs, Central and the surrounding parishes.
pages.service: Flood and hurricane cleanup dumpster rental

sections.heading: Photograph everything before it goes in.
sections.body: Your insurance adjuster or FEMA may want to see damaged items and a sample of the flooring and drywall. Take pictures and measurements of the water line before you start loading.

sections.heading: A flooded house fills a big box.
sections.body: Wet drywall, carpet and pad are heavy, and a muck-out on a whole house usually takes a 30 or 40 yard, sometimes more than one. Tell us the square footage and how high the water got.

sections.heading: When the curb pickup is weeks away.
sections.body: After a big flood, parish debris pickup can take a long time to reach every street. A dumpster lets you start drying the house out now, not when the trucks get to you.

faqs.a: Refrigerators and freezers need to have their refrigerant handled separately, so they usually cannot go in. Ask about washers, dryers and water heaters when you call.

pages.heading: Roofing dumpster rental in Baton Rouge.
pages.intro: Tear-offs go fastest when the crew can throw shingles straight into the box. A heavy-rated dumpster, close to the eave, sized for the squares coming off.
pages.seoTitle: Roofing Dumpster Rental Baton Rouge LA | Baton Rouge Dumpster
pages.seoDescription: Dumpsters for shingle tear-offs and re-roofs in Baton Rouge, Central, Zachary and Prairieville. Sized for heavy roofing debris.

sections.heading: Tell us squares and layers.
sections.body: Shingles are heavy, and a second layer nearly doubles it. With the number of squares and layers we can size a box that holds the job without going over weight.

sections.heading: Close to the roofline.
sections.body: Set it as close to the drip edge as the truck can reach and still pick it up. Tarps over the beds and the grass along the throw line make the magnet sweep easier at the end.

sections.heading: Everyone needs one at once.
sections.body: After a hurricane or a hail storm, roofers across Baton Rouge start tear-offs the same week. Book as soon as you have your jobs lined up.

sections.heading: Go at your own pace.
sections.body: Keep the dumpster for as long as it takes. Set aside anything to keep, sell or donate first, then load the rest.

sections.heading: Turn the unit and move on.
sections.body: Furniture left behind, old carpet and a full storage shed can all go in one box. A 20 yard usually handles a unit or two.

sections.heading: Hazardous waste goes elsewhere.
sections.body: Paint, chemicals, tires, batteries and refrigerant appliances need a different route. East Baton Rouge Parish holds household hazardous waste collection days; check the parish site for the next one.

pages.heading: Concrete and dirt dumpster rental in Baton Rouge.
pages.intro: Broken concrete, brick, block and dirt fill a dumpster by weight long before they fill it by volume. A small box rated for it is the right tool.
pages.seoTitle: Concrete & Dirt Dumpster Rental Baton Rouge | Baton Rouge Dumpster
pages.seoDescription: Small heavy-debris dumpsters for concrete, brick, dirt and driveway tear-outs in Baton Rouge and the surrounding parishes.

sections.heading: Weight, not space, is the limit.
sections.body: A cubic yard of concrete weighs well over a ton. A big dumpster filled with it cannot be lifted or hauled legally, so heavy loads go in a 10 yard, filled no higher than the line we point out.

sections.heading: Keep it clean.
sections.body: A load of only concrete or only dirt is easier to handle than one mixed with trash. If you are tearing out a driveway, keep the trash in a separate pile.
